description: Swift package workout log with a regression registry. Planted: a fixed bug undone and caught by a failing test (distance-only done-ness); a fixed bug undone with no test (log into a locked session); a pinning test deleted (R-003); a pinning test renamed so XCTest skips it (R-004); a README rule broken under a weakened test (correction overwrites the logged value); a documented feature not wired at launch (stats). Decoys: an open registry row, an accepted row with a deliberately skipped test, an intact pinned fix.
prompt: Changes were just made to this codebase. Run the full regression check and report the results.

must_find.why: isDone no longer counts distanceKm (R-002), so testDistanceOnlyFinishesCompleted fails: a distance-only workout locks as .started.
R-005's fixed shape (log throws .locked when lockedAt is set) is gone and no test covers it; sets can be appended to a finished workout, which also resets status.
The registry pins R-003 with HistoryTests › testEditCreatesNewVersion, which no longer exists. The fix itself is intact.
R-004's pinning test was renamed pendingDeleteDemoKeepsUserSessions, so XCTest never runs it. The fix itself is intact.
correct() appends a Correction and then overwrites entries[index].reps, breaking the append-only rule; the only correction test checks the count and effective value, so it still passes.
AppEnvironment.make() never calls stats.attach(to:), so onSessionLocked is never assigned at launch and the Stats total never changes; StatsTests wires it by hand and passes.

must_not_flag.why: Known open registry row R-006, not a regression.
R-001 is intact and pinned by a passing test.
Skipped on purpose for accepted row R-007.
